title: tusnady-lean: Lean formalization of the higher-dimensional lower bound for Tusnády's problem
description:
Lean 4 formalization of the higher-dimensional lower bound from Nicola Wengiel’s manuscript Resolving Tusnády’s Problem. The formalized result concerns every fixed dimension d ≥ 3 and gives worst-case combinatorial discrepancy Ω_d((log N)^(d − 1/2)) for closed lower orthants. The matching upper bound, planar lower bound, and algorithmic/polytope extensions are outside this version’s scope.

The main declaration is Tusnady.main_lower_bound_unconditional : Tusnady.HigherDimensionalLowerBound. Instructions and verification records are included in the repository.

License scope: Apache-2.0 applies to the software and its documentation. The included manuscript paper/Main.pdf is explicitly excluded: copyright 2026 Nicola Wengiel, all rights reserved. Reused formal proofs retain their attribution and license notices.
